# homeassistant_scheduler_schedules (Data Source)

Lists every schedule of the Scheduler integration (`scheduler`), e.g. to find the `schedule_id` to import into `homeassistant_scheduler_schedule`. The Scheduler integration (https://github.com/nielsfaber/scheduler-component, version 3.3) must be installed and set up; without it, reading fails with an error that says so.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every schedule of the Scheduler integration, e.g. to find what to import.
data "homeassistant_scheduler_schedules" "all" {}

# schedule_id => name of the heating schedules. schedule_id is unique; names may repeat or be null.
output "heating_schedules" {
  value = {
    for s in data.homeassistant_scheduler_schedules.all.schedules : s.schedule_id => s.name
    if contains(s.tags, "heating")
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `schedules` (Attributes List) The schedules, sorted by `name`, then by `schedule_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules))

<a id="nestedatt--schedules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule is enabled.
- `entities` (Set of String) Entities that the schedule's actions act on.
- `entity_id` (String) Entity ID of the schedule's switch.
- `name` (String) Name; null if it has none.
- `schedule_id` (String) ID of the schedule, the import ID.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags.
- `weekdays` (Set of String) Days on which it runs, e.g. `["mon", "fri"]` or `["daily"]`.
